desc:
KIDS CEREAL: Cookie Crisp Cereal is a delicious ready to eat breakfast addition the entire family will love; The perfect pantry staple

CHOCOLATE CHIP COOKIE TASTE: Enjoy chocolate chip cookie taste for breakfast - just add milk; Try dunking pieces in milk for a fun treat, pack crispy cereal as a lunch box snack, or add to cereal bar or snack mix recipes

VITAMINS AND MINERALS: Every serving of this cold cereal provides 12 vitamins and minerals and has a good source of calcium

WHOLE GRAIN: Each serving has 14g whole grain per serving (at least 48g recommended daily); A perfect addition to your pantry

CONTAINS: One cardboard box of crunchy Cookie Crisp Breakfast Cereal, Chocolate Chip Cookie Taste, Giant Size, 26.3 oz; Perfect for instant snacking, or a part of breakfast and meals
features:
Features

  1. Chocolate chip cookie–flavored breakfast cereal
  2. Made with whole grain as the first ingredient
  3. Giant size box – 26.3 oz (family-friendly size)
  4. Fortified with vitamins and minerals
  5. Naturally and artificially flavored
  6. Contains no high-fructose corn syrup

Benefits

  1. Fun and tasty way to start the morning, especially for kids
  2. Provides whole grain goodness in every serving
  3. Large size offers great value and lasts longer
  4. Helps support daily nutrition with added vitamins and minerals
  5. Can be enjoyed with or without milk
  6. Great as a breakfast or quick snack option
  7. Kid-approved taste encourages better breakfast habits
ingredients: Whole Grain Corn, Sugar, Corn Meal, Cocoa Processed with Alkali, Brown Sugar Syrup, Canola and/or Sunflower Oil, Corn Flour, Corn Syrup, Salt, Baking Soda, Natural Flavor, Annatto Extract Color, Rosemary Extract. Vitamins and Minerals: Calcium Carbonate, Tricalcium Phosphate, Vitamin C (sodium ascorbate), Iron and Zinc (mineral nutrients), A B Vitamin (niacinamide), Vitamin B6 (pyridoxine hydrochloride), Vitamin B1 (thiamin mononitrate), Vitamin A (palmitate), Vitamin B2 (riboflavin), A B Vitamin (folic acid), Vitamin B12, Vitamin D3.
